subject: L13 'mm Hg' fix landed in f19677a4 (lead-approved)
body: Per the lead's approval I changed _NUMBER_UNIT in apps/api/naadi_api/authoring/lint.py so the unit group also matches two-word units: (?:mm\s?Hg|cm\s?H2O)(?:/...)* before the generic token. tests/authoring/test_lint.py::test_l13_* now covers 'mm Hg', 'mmHg', 'mm Hg/min' (no error), an implausible 5800 mm Hg (error) and a bare value (error). tests/authoring, tests/content, tests/seed green; full validator 0 errors. Please review at your convenience. Claim released.
